title: Chapter 293: Drawer
html:
Sunlight warmed Chen Ge’s face as he stared at the phone. His chest tightened when the spinning needle began to slow. One hundred screams was no small investment; receiving something useless would be a terrible waste.

I deliberately chose the early morning. Surely it won’t be another Baleful Specter. Statistically speaking, it’s time for the Wheel to show me something else, isn’t it?

Chen Ge could not remember the last time he had felt so nervous. Anticipation swelled as he kept his eyes fixed on the screen.

It stopped!

“Lucky Spin completed. Congratulations for having won a Rare Special Item: The Drawer that Cannot Be Opened (Chance of Winning: 1/100)!”

Chen Ge drew a sharp breath at the message. Several names immediately came to mind. Cursed Love Letter, Crying Tape, Drawer That Cannot Be Opened… They sound like parts of the same collection!

Chen Ge continued to read.

“I felt someone watching me. He had to be hiding somewhere in the apartment. I searched every place a person could conceal himself but found nothing. Fear took hold. Whenever I sat at the desk with my back to the living room, that gaze returned. He was spying on me. I became terrified that the moment I looked away, he would creep up behind me.

“To protect myself, I hid a knife in the desk drawer. One night, the sensation returned. Unable to endure it any longer, I yanked open the drawer and reached for the knife. Only then did I realize the man had never been hiding in the living room.

“Congratulations, Specter’s Favored! You’ve won another rare Baleful Specter.

“Warning! If you win five Baleful Specters from the Wheel of Misfortune, your title will be upgraded!”

A morning breeze brushed his face beneath the warm sun. Chen Ge slowly looked away from the screen. Why a drawer this time?

The reward’s name alone told Chen Ge it was a Baleful Specter. He had spun the wheel four times and received three Specters. At this rate, his title would soon be upgraded.

At this rate, I may never draw anything else. But how is a drawer supposed to help me fight the Ghost Stories Society?Chen Ge suspected he needed a larger backpack. Zhang Ya’s love letter had odds of one in a thousand, while this drawer was one in a hundred. It should be weaker than Zhang Ya but perhaps stronger than Xu Yin. At least it’s rare. That’s better than nothing.

Chen Ge hurried into the Props Room. Physical rewards from the Wheel normally appeared inside the wooden box his parents had left him, which he stored there. Yet no matter how thoroughly he searched, he could not find the Drawer That Could Not Be Opened.

Could the black phone be referring to the actual drawers inside the Props Room?

He opened the room’s drawers one by one and found a rental notice inside one.

“Room 304, Jiujiang Third Hospital’s Staff Residence.

“Layout: Two bedrooms, one living room, one bathroom.

“Brand-new home! Premium furniture! Forty-six-inch LED television! Large sofa! Hardwood floors! Available immediately!

“Rental: 900 per month

“Phone number…”

The flyer’s barrage of exclamation marks left Chen Ge suspicious. Two bedrooms and a living room in a decent location should cost about three thousand a month. Why is this place so cheap?

The notice appeared several years old, but even then, nine hundred a month was absurdly low. Something is wrong with this apartment. It’s probably haunted.

Though the drawer itself was absent, the notice made the black phone’s instructions clear.

I’ll have to collect this new friend personally.Chen Ge leaned the hammer against the wall and checked the time. I can sleep for half an hour before the park opens at nine. This afternoon, I’ll visit Fan Yu and Jiang Ling at the Children’s Home, then deal with the drawer on my way back.

After changing clothes, Chen Ge fed the white cat. He attempted to use the food as a reward and train it to locate its own meals, but after considerable effort concluded that caring for Xiaoxiao and the Pen Spirit was much easier.

If I can’t teach the cat to find its own food, perhaps I can teach Xiaoxiao to feed it.Chen Ge ruffled Xiaoxiao’s hair and realized that many of his employees’ abilities remained unexplored.

…

The Haunted House opened at 9:00 a.m. to a noticeably larger crowd. Director Luo’s promotion had helped, but Chen Ge believed the attraction’s quality deserved most of the credit.

To support the campaign, New Century Park had introduced several changes. Visitors could purchase tickets online and share promotional links on social media for additional discounts. After those reductions, admission cost very little.

Many people who had already completed one-star scenarios invited friends to attempt the harder attractions. After all, entering a Haunted House with companions was entirely different from facing it alone.

As the Haunted House grew more popular, strategy guides appeared online. More groups cleared its two-star scenarios, though none achieved a perfect result. The record belonged to a mixed team of Jiujiang Medical University students and other visitors. Working together, the twelve of them found twenty-one name tags in twenty minutes.

To Chen Ge’s disappointment, when one group finally assembled to challenge the three-star Third Sick Hall, they retreated the instant he opened its door and revealed mattresses strewn along the corridor like bodies in a mass grave.

Some visitors are already challenging the Third Sick Hall. Looks like I need to unlock a new scenario soon.

Chen Ge finally rested when the park closed at 6:00 p.m. After Xu Wan left, he took the rental notice and departed New Century Park. He stopped at a supermarket for snacks and toys before visiting Jiujiang Children’s Home. Believing Chen Ge had finally decided to take Fan Yu home, the director personally welcomed him.

Naturally, the director was disappointed. Chen Ge carried the gifts into Fan Yu and Jiang Ling’s room, where the two children, unaware of his visit, sat drawing in silence.
